#!/bin/bash
# Horizon server install (packaging/server/pterodactyl-egg.json). Runs in the installer container with the server
# folder at /mnt/server (override with HORIZON_INSTALL_DIR for a dry run). Downloads the server build of the Horizon
# release named by HORIZON_VERSION from GitHub, checks it against the SHA-256 GitHub publishes, and writes
# horizon-start.sh. Nothing of Mojang's is downloaded: the prepared game files go in resources/ (docs/hosting.md).
set -eu
DIR="${HORIZON_INSTALL_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
REPO=horizon-rust/horizon
ASSET=horizon-server-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
TAG="${HORIZON_VERSION:-nightly}"
[ -n "$TAG" ] || TAG=nightly
die() { echo "horizon install: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v curl >/dev/null || die "curl is needed"
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null || die "sha256sum is needed"
mkdir -p "$DIR"
cd "$DIR"
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
api() { curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/$1"; }
JSON=$(api "tags/$TAG") || die "no release $TAG on GitHub"
FIELDS=$(printf '%s\n' "$JSON" | awk -v asset="$ASSET" '
  /"name": / { line = $0; sub(/.*"name": "/, "", line); sub(/".*/, "", line); current = line }
  current == asset && /"digest": / { line = $0; sub(/.*"digest": "sha256:/, "", line); sub(/".*/, "", line); digest = line }
  current == asset && /"browser_download_url": / { line = $0; sub(/.*"browser_download_url": "/, "", line); sub(/".*/, "", line); url = line }
  END { print url; print digest }')
URL=$(printf '%s\n' "$FIELDS" | sed -n 1p)
DIGEST=$(printf '%s\n' "$FIELDS" | sed -n 2p)
[ -n "$URL" ] || die "release $TAG has no $ASSET"
[ -n "$DIGEST" ] || die "release $TAG publishes no SHA-256 for $ASSET"
echo "Downloading Horizon $TAG ($ASSET)..."
curl -fL --progress-bar -o "$TMP/$ASSET" "$URL"
GOT=$(sha256sum "$TMP/$ASSET" | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$GOT" = "$DIGEST" ] || die "$ASSET doesn't match its SHA-256 (got $GOT, expected $DIGEST): not installed"
mkdir -p "$TMP/x"
tar -xzf "$TMP/$ASSET" -C "$TMP/x" --strip-components=1
[ -x "$TMP/x/horizon-server" ] || die "$ASSET holds no horizon-server"
# Replace the program, keep the server's own files (server.toml, worlds, resources/).
rm -rf "$DIR/horizon"
mv "$TMP/x" "$DIR/horizon"
mkdir -p "$DIR/resources"
cat > "$DIR/horizon-start.sh" <<'START'
#!/bin/sh
# Starts horizon-server in the server folder of a hosting panel (the Pterodactyl egg; docs/hosting.md).
# The program sits in ./horizon/, the prepared game files in ./resources/. The first start writes server.toml
# from the panel's HORIZON_* variables (horizon-server init: HORIZON_EULA, WORLD, SEED, WHITELIST, PLAYERS, OP,
# ONLINE); the port always follows the panel's allocation (SERVER_PORT).
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
if [ ! -f server.toml ]; then
  ./horizon/horizon-server init --yes --port "${SERVER_PORT:-25565}" || exit 1
fi
sed -i "s/^port = .*/port = ${SERVER_PORT:-25565}/" server.toml
exec ./horizon/horizon-server run
START
chmod +x "$DIR/horizon-start.sh"
echo "Installed Horizon $TAG. Upload the prepared 26.3 game files to resources/ (docs/hosting.md), set HORIZON_EULA to true, and start the server."
